LOGIN_PROBLEMS.NAME: Login problems
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.SUMMARY: See when login complaints start increasing.
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.CONDITION: A customer says they cannot sign in to their account, including failed password resets and verification codes that never arrive. Exclude questions about changing a password while already signed in.

MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.NAME: Missing order updates
MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.CONDITION: A customer says an order confirmation, shipping update, or delivery notice did not arrive, or arrived for the wrong order. Exclude customers asking where a parcel is when they did receive the tracking email.

COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.NAME: Competitor mentions
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.SUMMARY: Find conversations worth following up on.
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.CONDITION: A customer compares us with a competing product, says they are evaluating one, or mentions they may switch. Exclude customers who moved to us from a competitor and are asking how to import their data.

FEATURE_REQUESTS.NAME: Feature requests
FEATURE_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Keep a running count of conversations about unmet needs.
FEATURE_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for a capability the product does not currently offer, or asks whether something is possible and it is not. Exclude questions about how to use a feature that already exists.

REFUND_REQUESTS.NAME: Refund requests
REFUND_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Bring a consistent definition to your weekly refund request count.
REFUND_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for money back on a payment they already made, including duplicate charges and refunds after cancelling. Exclude questions about the refund policy and requests for a discount.

CANCELLATION_INTENT.NAME: Cancellation intent
CANCELLATION_INTENT.SUMMARY: Find customers who may need a conversation before they leave.
CANCELLATION_INTENT.CONDITION: A customer says they intend to cancel, will not renew, or plan to stop using the product. Exclude requests to reduce seats or downgrade, and cancellations the customer takes back in the same conversation.

PAYMENT_FAILURES.NAME: Payment failures
PAYMENT_FAILURES.SUMMARY: Spot customers who are blocked from paying.
PAYMENT_FAILURES.CONDITION: A customer says a payment, checkout, or invoice payment failed, or their card was declined. Exclude refund requests, disputes about completed charges, and general questions about payment methods.

PRODUCT_ERRORS.NAME: Product errors
PRODUCT_ERRORS.SUMMARY: See when errors and crashes start spreading.
PRODUCT_ERRORS.CONDITION: A customer reports an error, crash, unavailable service, or severe slowness that prevents them from completing a task. Exclude sign-in problems and questions about how to use a working feature.

ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.NAME: Issue still unresolved
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.SUMMARY: Find conversations that need another pass.
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.CONDITION: A customer says a suggested fix did not work, the same problem returned, or their issue remains after support said it was resolved. Exclude first-time reports and requests only asking for a status update.

ESCALATION_REQUESTS.NAME: Escalation requests
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Surface requests that need prompt attention.
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer explicitly asks for a human agent, manager, specialist, or higher support tier because their issue has not been resolved. Exclude routine transfers and sales requests.

TOLZAR_SETTINGS.TITLE: Tolzar settings
TOLZAR_SETTINGS.LEAD: One home for what Tolzar does for this workspace. AI features run in Shadow: they act inside Tolzar and never send to customers.

HINT.workspace_settings: Hours, languages, templates and descriptions for this workspace, on top of the defaults. Only what you change is stored.
HINT.pipeline: Your sales stages, where a contact's stage and deal value are stored, and the currency. Dashboard, Pipeline, Contacts and Reports follow it.
HINT.meta_app: Your business's own Meta app: Messenger, Instagram DMs and comments arrive here in listen-only mode. Staff keep answering in Meta Business Suite.
HINT.go_live: Shadow or live, per inbox. Owner only. Today nothing is live.
HINT.usage: What this workspace used in the last 30 days.
HINT.audit: Who changed what, and when. Secret values are never shown.
HINT.export: Everything this workspace holds in one file. The link works for 7 days.
HINT.sla: Flag conversations where a customer waited too long for a person. A label and a private note; customers see nothing.
HINT.qa: Every conversation scored against your rubric; a card per team member for the last 7 days.
HINT.media: Read customers' voice notes and photos on Tolzar's own server. Files are never stored.
HINT.documents: Read attachments customers send (PDFs) in Shadow, to help triage.
HINT.recovery: For leads that went quiet, the AI drafts 3 follow-ups from their own conversation (shadow: notes only).
HINT.learned: Questions your team answers the same way again and again. Approve one and the AI learns it, in Shadow first.
HINT.brief: Last week's top questions, lost-deal reasons, objections, competitors and knowledge gaps.
HINT.ask: Ask a question in plain words; get the numbers and a chart.
HINT.dedupe: The same person, written to you from several places. Review and merge; Tolzar never merges on its own.
HINT.links: Links and QR codes per campaign; the first message tells Reports which campaign brought it.
HINT.broadcasts: Pick an audience and see exactly who would receive it. Shadow: nothing is sent.
HINT.mcp: Let your own AI tools read this workspace's Tolzar data. Read-only.
HINT.roles: Who may do what in this workspace.
HINT.connections: Read comments on your pages (read-only); replies are drafted in Shadow.
HINT.disclosure: Tell people they are talking to an AI (EU AI Act). The line is added to the first AI reply of a conversation, never twice.
HINT.retention: How long Tolzar keeps its AI records (decisions, notes, logs). Older rows are removed once a day. Conversations and contacts follow the inbox's own settings.
HINT.privacy: Export or erase what Tolzar holds about one person (GDPR access and erasure).
HINT.sms: Reach customers by SMS through your own provider account. Shadow: Tolzar shows the exact SMS it would send.
HINT.crm: Keep contacts in step with HubSpot, Zoho CRM or Pipedrive. Dry run: Tolzar lists what it would change and changes nothing.
HINT.commerce: Connect your shop: prices from the catalogue, order status on request (read-only), a cart-recovery workflow.
HINT.negotiation: How far the AI may move on price. A guard checks every reply; anything outside the limits goes to a colleague.
HINT.agent_teams: Which AI agent speaks for which team (sales, support...). Empty uses the workspace's default agent.
HINT.tuning: Once a day Tolzar suggests up to 3 edits to your agent's instructions, from QA notes, guard stops and your team's answers.
HINT.whatsapp_listen: Receive a WhatsApp number that another platform already runs, with your business's own Meta app. Owner only.

DOCUMENTS.EXPLAIN: The text is read for triage only and is never stored.

SLA.MENTION: Also alert the assigned person (a mention: in-app notification + phone push)

RECOVERY.TOUCH_DAYS: Follow-up days after a lead goes quiet (up to three, e.g. 1, 3, 7)

ROLES.RULE_MANAGER: Manager: AI agents, workflows, reports and settings; not export, connections or roles.

TRUST.KV_DAYS: Keep customer memory, QA scores, transcripts and plans for (days)

TRUST.CONFIRM_TEXT: Tolzar's memory, AI decisions, scores and transcripts for contact {id} are removed for good. This cannot be undone.

AGENT.NAME: Agent name
AGENT.HINT_INACTIVE: Pick a ready-made template to start from. The agent is created switched off: you review it in AI Agents and turn it on when you are ready; it then runs in Shadow.
AGENT.NO_TEMPLATE_HINT: Create agents later in AI Agents.

CHANNEL.TITLE: Connect a channel
CHANNEL.READY: {name} is ready: {chunks} passages read from your site, {workflows} workflows added as drafts.
CHANNEL.HINT: Start with the website chat or email; WhatsApp and Instagram come with the Meta connection.

TEAM.TITLE: Invite your team
TEAM.HINT: Add the people who answer customers. You can set Owner / Manager roles in Tolzar settings.

WATCH.TITLE: Watch it work
WATCH.HINT: Your agent starts in Shadow: it handles every conversation inside Tolzar and you see what it would have done next to what your team did. Switch it on when the scoreboard says it's ready.

TOLZAR_ONBOARDING.ALREADY: This workspace is already set up.
TOLZAR_ONBOARDING.OWNER_ONLY: Only the workspace Owner can run the setup.
TOLZAR_ONBOARDING.FAILED: The setup did not go through. Try again.

CHECKLIST.TITLE: Getting started
CHECKLIST.HINT: Everything runs in Shadow: Tolzar shows what it would do and sends nothing to customers.
CHECKLIST.CREATED: Set up. {name} is ready (switched off, {chunks} passages read from your site).
CHECKLIST.CREATED_NO_AGENT: Set up. Create your first AI agent next.
CHECKLIST.FAILED: The checklist could not be loaded.

TOLZAR_AGENCY.TITLE: Agency console
TOLZAR_AGENCY.LEAD: Every workspace you manage, with usage and AI quality side by side. Each client sees only its own workspace.
TOLZAR_AGENCY.NEW_HINT: New client workspaces are created from the account switcher (Create new account).
TOLZAR_AGENCY.PRODUCT_NAME: Product name this client's team sees
TOLZAR_AGENCY.SUPPORT: Support e-mail shown in the app
TOLZAR_AGENCY.APPLY_HINT: Saved per workspace and applied for everyone in it: the name in the browser tab, the colour on buttons and links, the logo (an https image) as the tab icon. The support e-mail is stored for client messages; nothing shows it yet.

TOLZAR_RESULTS.TITLE: Results
TOLZAR_RESULTS.SUBTITLE: What Tolzar is worth for this workspace, in plain numbers
TOLZAR_RESULTS.WOULD_BE_NOTE: Tolzar runs in Shadow here: its replies are drafts. Values marked would-be are what customers would have seen.

FACT.FIRST_REPLY: Your team's typical first reply took {staff}; Tolzar answers in {tolzar} ({n} conversations compared).
FACT.FIRST_REPLY_WOULD: Your team's typical first reply took {staff}; Tolzar would answer in {tolzar} ({n} conversations compared).
FACT.NO_FIRST_REPLY: No first replies to compare yet.
FACT.AI_SHARE: The AI wrote {share}% of {n} replies on its own; guards stepped in {guards} times.
FACT.OFF_HOURS: {n} of {of} new leads came in outside working hours.
FACT.SHADOW_NOTE: Tolzar is in Shadow here: its replies are drafts, so its times are what customers would have seen.

TOLZAR_PIPELINE.STAGES_HINT: In funnel order. Contacts with no stage count in the first one; the last two are won and lost.
TOLZAR_PIPELINE.LABEL: Shown as
TOLZAR_PIPELINE.STAGE_FIELDS_HINT: Contact attribute keys, best first, comma-separated. Tolzar writes the first; the others are read when it is empty (for example an imported stage).

TOLZAR_META_APP.LISTEN_ONLY: Listen only: nothing is sent from Tolzar
TOLZAR_META_APP.INTRO: Create the app in your business's own Meta portfolio, then paste its App ID and App secret here. Tolzar receives your Page's Messenger messages, Instagram DMs and comments; staff keep answering in Meta Business Suite.
TOLZAR_META_APP.SECRET_SAVED: Saved ••••{last4} (type a new one to replace it)
TOLZAR_META_APP.WEBHOOK_URL: Webhook callback URL (paste it in your app: Webhooks, for Page and Instagram)
TOLZAR_META_APP.VERIFY_ONCE: Shown once: paste it into Meta now.
TOLZAR_META_APP.TOKEN: Access token (a system user of your portfolio, with this page)

TOLZAR_AGENTS.BEHAVIOUR_HINT: What this agent may use when it drafts a reply (in Shadow it only drafts; nothing is sent).

SWITCH.quote_prices: Quote prices from the price source

SWITCH_HINT.enabled: Uses this agent's knowledge, prices and skills. Off: instructions only.
SWITCH_HINT.answer_from_knowledge: Cites the links and texts below; says it will check when they don't cover a question.
SWITCH_HINT.quote_prices: Only prices from the saved source or upload. Saving a source switches this on.

TOLZAR_AGENTS.KNOWLEDGE_INDEXED: Indexed. This agent now has {total} knowledge passage. | Indexed. This agent now has {total} knowledge passages.
TOLZAR_AGENTS.KNOWLEDGE_OFF: Answer from knowledge sources is off, so these sources are not used.

TOLZAR_AGENT_TEST.REPLACED: Shadow would send this instead of the model's draft

REASON.SEMANTIC_OFFER: offer check: looks like a discount
REASON.PRICE: price not in the price table

TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.OWNER_ONLY_EDIT: Only an Owner can change these settings. You can read them.
TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.NEVER_CHANGED: Not changed yet: everything is the default.
TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.WILL_RESET: Goes back to the default when you save
TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.CONFLICT: Someone else saved these settings while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your unsaved edits will be lost.
TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.INVALID_STORED: The saved settings no longer fit the defaults, so the workspace runs on its defaults until they are fixed:
TOLZAR_WORKSPACE.LOAD_FAILED: The settings could not be loaded.

FIELD_HINT.workspace_name: Also what you type to confirm going live.
FIELD_HINT.languages: Language codes, comma separated: en, de, fr

GO_LIVE.BANNER_SHADOW: Nothing is live. Every inbox runs in Shadow: the AI drafts inside Tolzar and never writes to customers.
GO_LIVE.BANNER_LIVE: LIVE: the AI replies to real customers in {n} inbox(es) of this workspace.
GO_LIVE.WARNING: Going live lets the AI reply to real customers in that inbox. Tolzar refuses unless every live check passes.
GO_LIVE.OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner can switch an inbox live or use the kill switch.
GO_LIVE.CONFIRM_BODY: The AI will reply to real customers in this inbox. Type the workspace name to confirm:
GO_LIVE.REFUSED: Tolzar did not switch this inbox live:

REASON.no_price_table: The AI agent has no price table loaded. Add a price source to the agent (AI Agents) and test it.
REASON.price_table_without_prices: The agent's price table has no prices in it.
REASON.legacy_path: Replies still go through the old path. Turn on the AI agent's own reply path first.
REASON.mirror_inbox: This is a read-only mirror inbox. It never goes live.
REASON.negotiation_on: Negotiation is switched on. It has to be off (or in Shadow) before going live.
REASON.no_active_agent: This workspace has no active AI agent.
REASON.live_check_error: The live check could not run. Try again later.
REASON.not_live_ready: The live checks are not clear yet.

GO_LIVE.KILL: Kill switch: everything back to Shadow
GO_LIVE.KILL_HINT: Puts every inbox of this workspace back to Shadow at once, including inboxes the defaults set live.
GO_LIVE.KILL_CONFIRM: Put every inbox of this workspace back to Shadow now?
GO_LIVE.NO_INBOXES: This workspace has no inboxes yet.
GO_LIVE.LOCKED: The kill switch is on: no inbox can go live until an Owner releases it.
GO_LIVE.RELEASE_CONFIRM: Release the kill switch? Nothing goes live by releasing it; each inbox still needs its own go-live.
GO_LIVE.RELEASE_DONE: Kill switch released. Every inbox is still in Shadow.

PRICE.TITLE: Price source
PRICE.HINT: Where this agent's prices come from. Tolzar only reads them; the agent may quote only prices found here.
PRICE.TEST_FIRST: Test the fetch before you save.
PRICE.OWNER_SAVE: Only an Owner can test or save the price source.
PRICE.COMMERCE_HINT: Prices come from your shop's catalogue sync (Settings, Shop).

PROBLEM.hours_range: Refresh hours must be between 1 and 168.

TOLZAR_HONEST.SKILLS_SOON: Skills are read by the brain as proposals only, once 'Let this agent propose skills' is on. What you saved is kept.
TOLZAR_HONEST.SMS: Preview only: nothing is sent, and no fallback uses these settings yet
TOLZAR_HONEST.CRM: Dry run — nothing is written to your CRM

TOLZAR_SKILLS.TITLE: AI skills
TOLZAR_SKILLS.BANNER: Skills are proposals only: Tolzar writes 'would do' notes; nothing is executed.
TOLZAR_SKILLS.ENABLED_HINT: Off: the brain ignores every skill below. On: when a reply matches a skill, Tolzar adds a private 'would do' note for your team.
TOLZAR_SKILLS.DRY_RUN: Workflows: only note which workflow would start (always on)
TOLZAR_SKILLS.WHEN_PLACEHOLDER: In your own words: when should the agent propose this?
TOLZAR_SKILLS.NONE_AVAILABLE: Nothing to pick in this workspace yet.
TOLZAR_SKILLS.MISSING: No longer in this workspace: click to remove
TOLZAR_SKILLS.CLOSE_HINT: Proposes closing the conversation when the task is done.
TOLZAR_SKILLS.SAVE_BLOCKED: Fix the AI skills above before saving (or switch skills off to keep a draft).

TYPE.assign: Assign to a team or person

TYPE_HINT.assign: Propose handing the conversation to a team or a team member.
TYPE_HINT.update_fields: Propose saving details from the chat into contact or conversation fields.
TYPE_HINT.change_stage: Propose moving the contact along your pipeline.
TYPE_HINT.close: Propose resolving the conversation when the task is done.
TYPE_HINT.add_tag: Propose a label on the conversation.
TYPE_HINT.trigger_workflow: Propose starting one of your workflows.

ERROR.duplicate: This skill is already in the list.
ERROR.when_too_long: Keep 'when to use it' to {max} characters.
ERROR.needs_values: Pick at least one value, or untick this skill.
